measures.label: Child poverty
measures.unit: per cent of children in low income households, after housing costs
measures.source: DWP, Children in low income families: local area statistics (relative low income, after housing costs)

measures.label: Unemployment
measures.unit: per cent of economically active people aged 16 and over (model based estimate)
measures.source: ONS, model-based estimates of unemployment for local authorities (Nomis labour market profiles)

measures.label: Fuel poverty
measures.unit: per cent of households in fuel poverty (low income, low energy efficiency)

measures.label: Life expectancy
measures.unit: years at birth, women and men averaged
measures.source: ONS, Life expectancy for local areas of Great Britain

measures.label: Adults overweight or obese
measures.unit: per cent of adults overweight or obese (Active Lives survey)
measures.source: OHID, Public health profiles (Fingertips), from Sport England Active Lives

measures.label: Air pollution
measures.unit: per cent of adult deaths linked to fine particle (PM2.5) pollution
measures.source: UKHSA and OHID, Fraction of mortality attributable to particulate air pollution (Fingertips indicator 93861)

measures.label: Gigabit broadband
measures.unit: per cent of premises that can get gigabit broadband

measures.label: Indoor 4G from all four networks
measures.unit: per cent of premises with indoor 4G from all four networks
